newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Wednesday easier against hard currencies on the back of slight import pressure, dealers said.

"There was a little bit of importer demand and the dollar lost a cent against the U.S. dollar. The market was a little short to start with and even though the payments were minimal the (exchange) rates went up a bit as people sought to protect their positions," a dealer commented.
At Wednesday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 10.3100/3300 against the U.S. unit from Tuesday's 10.3000/3200 and was at 16.1250/1640 from 16.0210/0700 against sterling.
Against the mark it softened to 6.8370/8510 from 6.8030/8180 and lost ground to 2.2830/2890 from 2.2800/2870 versus the rand.
